description: The main window: native-menu, update-status, sign-in-link and mail-connect events, dragging the window by the macOS toolbar rows, setting the window theme (Settings › Appearance), opening allowlisted https links, public https job-posting links and webmail inboxes, the app's own update commands (status, check, restart to update, Stable/Beta channel), sign-in commands (take the checked sign-in link, report the signed-in state to the menu), take the checked mail connect result (bruteforcehr://connected), export commands (print the CV's HTML to a PDF offline, save an exported file such as a CV, an interview .ics or a CSV through the native Save dialog) and the notification plugin's permission check, permission request and notify (opt-in interview prep reminders and mail notifications). The updater, deep-link and dialog plugins' commands are not granted; the hidden CV print windows get no capability.
